static_traits.name: Li Bowen
static_traits.social_status: The social support system is weak; tends to handle problems alone
static_traits.medical_history: Without major physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; without similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, rather negative tone; cooperation okay but with doubt and self-criticism; speech shows tendencies of catastrophizing, mind reading, and predicting the future; often coping with Anxiety through avoidance and Distraction strategies.

basic_info.main_problem: I notice that I shop online excessively, and worry that others will judge me for it.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that excessive online shopping is affecting my financial situation and mental health, and therefore I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: About a year ago experiencing a particularly difficult emotional period, then began excessive online shopping; the problem gradually worsened since, developing into multiple orders per day, with guilt and Anxiety after each purchase.

Months ago doing a solo performance at church, almost no one gave feedback afterward; accordingly believing others do not like own singing, causing strong Anxiety and Self-doubt before solos, then developing tendencies to avoid choir practice and wanting to miss performances; worrying about this at night and affecting sleep.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others

special_situations.event: Every time completing an online purchase and seeing the order or bill records
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my behavior is known by others, they will definitely think I am strange and distance themselves because of it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hiding online shopping, trying to limit purchases, easing guilt and Anxiety through Distraction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am strange; I did wrong

special_situations.event: After the church solo ended, almost no one around gave feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not actively praise, it means they do not like my performance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces attending choir rehearsals or solos, avoiding facing possible negative evaluation

special_situations.event: When a solo performance or rehearsal approaches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform perfectly, I will completely fail and be laughed at
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding performances in advance, Displacing Anxiety with Distraction

special_situations.event: Facing financial reminders (such as bills and budget pressure)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Because I have already over-purchased, the consequences will be unmanageable, my life and relationships will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing Distraction or shopping again after Anxiety worsened to temporarily ease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things will get worse and worse, I cannot hold on anymore

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by others and genuinely affirmed (including understanding of my singing and personal habits)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being shamed or seen as weird
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being evaluated through concealment and avoidance

object_relations.object_representation: Picky and indifferent onlookers (will not give genuine affirmation, only negate or perfunctory)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When not Receiving feedback from others after performing or speaking, or when invited to examine automatic thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' Silence as rejection and dislike (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting a cautious, hesitant tone, emphasizing others' negative views, avoiding directly exploring own feelings; when necessary maintaining a sense of security through avoidance or Displacing the topic.

manifestations: Living alone,The social support system is weak; tends to handle problems alone
Keeps the online shopping habit secret, affecting the building of deeper connections
Being swept by Anxiety before performances, hard to choose and express autonomously
outcomes: Weakened sense of control over the pace of life

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets others' silence as dislike of her singing
Believing others' comfort is not sincere, just to avoid hurting oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracting through watching TV or playing phone games during nighttime Anxiety rather than facing thoughts directly
Tending to Displace attention when talking about Anxiety topics

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Before the solo, repeatedly criticizes himself, worrying 'I will mess it up'
Overly cares about others' evaluations; hard to accept neutral feedback

exception_events.target_problem: When others' evaluations are unclear (like no one giving feedback after a performance), the client typically interprets it as negative, choosing secrecy and avoidance, Anxiety worsened.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When communicating with wife and choir members, the client did not completely keep secret and avoid as usual, but actively expressed feelings and sought support, Anxiety easing somewhat in a short time.
exception_events.reason: Cues: different actions — active communication and expression; different support — comfort and understanding from partner and peers, reducing current Anxiety intensity.

exception_events.target_problem: When worries about solos and others' evaluations appear at night, the client typically falls into persistent Anxiety and insomnia.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On some nights the client chose to Distract by watching TV or playing phone games, not ruminating persistently as before, Anxiety intensity briefly decreasing.
exception_events.reason: Cues: different actions — adopting Distraction strategies, reducing rumination and involvement with negative thoughts.

positive_force: Having clear problem awareness and actively seeking help
Willing to try cognitive and behavioral strategies (such as observing thoughts and alternative perspectives)
Work functioning not yet affected, having basic self-efficacy
Able to express troubles to significant others to some extent and receive support
negative_force: Weak social support system and tendency to cope alone
Cognitive biases like catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future, and personalization marked
Difficulty with impulse control; relies on avoidance and distraction strategies
Shame and fear of evaluation lead to avoiding practice and interpersonal distancing
Increased financial pressure, in turn aggravating the Anxiety cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive online shopping (ordering multiple times a day)
antecedent: Habitual impulses formed after emotional distress
Worsening during emotional Anxiety or nighttime worries
Being alone, more likely to occur when lacking Social support
target_behavior.core_reason: Using shopping as Coping strategies to temporarily ease emotional distress and Loneliness, forming an 'impulse — brief relief' Reinforcement cycle
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome internal states (Anxiety, Loneliness) and gaining brief comfort and sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Increased financial pressure, repeated guilt and Anxiety after purchases, further affecting relationships and daily life

target_behavior.behavior: High Anxiety and avoidance tendencies before solos / rehearsals
antecedent: The experience of no feedback from others after a church solo
When a solo performance or rehearsal approaches
When thinking about others' possible negative evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting others' Silence as negation and catastrophically Anticipating failure, triggering Fear of shame and rejection
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and humiliation in the short term, thereby reducing immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Avoiding choir practice and performances, Sleep affected, overall mood and Decreased confidence
